6/S0.subgoal: Outline the four distinct phases of the historical evolution of VR.

6/S1.subgoal: Describe the foundational developments and key inventions of the early era of VR.

6/S2.subgoal: Detail the major technological innovations and milestones of the formative years of VR.

6/S3.subgoal: Compare the technological and commercial advancements that occurred during the modern phase of VR.

6/S4.subgoal: Explain the factors that led to the recent growth and popularization of VR in the modern era.
